meta.name: orchestrate
meta.description: This skill should be used at the boundary where work crosses from intent to execution: a goal that needs breaking down and delegating, or a plan that has converged (in conversation or plan mode) and is ready to build. Explicit asks to "orchestrate" or "cascade" work also invoke it. Coordinate the cascade hierarchy - slice the goal or plan vertically, delegate each slice to a lead for planning and delivery, review and approve plans, and sign off on results.
